Message.Name: Market Definition Message
Message.Description: The Market Definition message is generated at the start of the business day for each market segment.

Field.Name: MarketCode
Field.Description: Market segment identifier.

Field.Name: MarketName
Field.Description: Market segment name.

Field.Name: CurrencyCode
Field.Description: Base currency code of the market segment.

Field.Name: NumberOfSecurities
Field.Description: Number of securities within the market segment.

Message.Name: Security Definition Message
Message.Description: The Security Definition message contains all the reference data for a security. Security Definition messages may be received intraday (for example the FreeText field may be updated during the day).

Field.Name: SecurityCode
Field.Description: Uniquely identifies a security available for trading. 5 digit security codes with possible values 1 to 99999.

Field.Name: MarketCode
Field.Description: Market segment identifier.

Field.Name: ISINCode
Field.Description: ISIN code of the security.

Field.Name: InstrumentType
Field.Description: Instrument type of the security.

Field.Name: ProductType
Field.Description: Product type of the security.

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: Padding.

Field.Name: SpreadTableCode
Field.Description: Spread table code of the security.

Field.Name: SecurityShortName
Field.Description: Security short name.

Field.Name: CurrencyCode
Field.Description: Currency code of the security.

Field.Name: SecurityNameGCCS
Field.Description: Security name in Traditional Chinese using Unicode UTF-16LE encoding.

Field.Name: SecurityNameGB
Field.Description: Security name in Simplified Chinese using Unicode UTF-16LE encoding.

Field.Name: LotSize
Field.Description: Board lot size for the security.

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: Padding.

Field.Name: PreviousClosingPrice
Field.Description: Previous closing price of the security, or NAV published by issuer for ETF or L&I Product on the trading day before its first day listing. 3 implied decimal places.

Field.Name: VCMFlag
Field.Description: Indicates whether Volatility Control Mechanism (VCM) is applicable to the security.

Field.Name: ShortSellFlag
Field.Description: Indicator for short-sell authorization.

Field.Name: CASFlag
Field.Description: Indicates whether Closing Auction Session (CAS) is applicable to the security.

Field.Name: CCASSFlag
Field.Description: Indicates whether or not the security is a CCASS security.

Field.Name: DummySecurityFlag
Field.Description: Dummy Security Flag.

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: Padding.

Field.Name: StampDutyFlag
Field.Description: Indicator for stamp duty requirement.

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: Padding.

Field.Name: ListingDate
Field.Description: Date of security listing. YYYYMMDD. Value is 19000101 for unknown listing date.

Field.Name: DelistingDate
Field.Description: Date of security delisting. YYYYMMDD. Value is 0 if no date exists.

Field.Name: FreeText
Field.Description: Free text associated to the security. When there is no free text, spaces are present instead.

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: Padding.

Field.Name: POSFlag
Field.Description: Indicates whether Pre-Opening Session (POS) is applicable to the security.

Field.Name: POSUpperLimit
Field.Description: Upper price limit of all orders in POS Order Input period, and At-auction Limit sell order in POS No Cancellation and Random Matching periods. 3 implied decimal places. 0 means Not available.

Field.Name: POSLowerLimit
Field.Description: Lower price limit of all orders in POS Order Input period, and At-auction Limit buy order in POS No Cancellation and Random Matching periods. 3 implied decimal places. 0 means Not available.

Field.Name: DomainStmtSecurityCode
Field.Description: Security code of the corresponding Domain Settlement Counter. Value is 0 if the security itself is already the domain settlement counter.

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: Padding.

Field.Name: EFNFlag
Field.Description: EFN Indicator (Bonds Specific Data).

Field.Name: AccruedInterest
Field.Description: Accrued interest of the security. 3 implied decimal places.

Field.Name: CouponRate
Field.Description: Coupon rate of a bond security. 3 implied decimal places.

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: Padding.

Field.Name: FaceValueComposite
Field.Description: Face value of a bond security. See DecimalsInFaceValue for the number of decimal places. 0 means Not available.

Field.Name: FaceValueCurrency
Field.Description: Currency code of Face Value.

Field.Name: MaturityDate
Field.Description: Date of maturity of a bond security. YYYYMMDD.

Field.Name: InvestorType
Field.Description: Investor type of a bond security.

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: Padding.

Field.Name: ConversionRatio
Field.Description: Conversion ratio for Structured Product. 3 implied decimal places. 0 means Not available.

Field.Name: StrikePrice1
Field.Description: Strike price of the security if it has only one strike price, or Lower strike price of the security if it has lower and upper strike prices. 3 implied decimal places.

Field.Name: StrikePrice2
Field.Description: Upper strike price of the security if it has lower and upper strike prices. 3 implied decimal places. Value is 0 if the security has only one strike price.

Field.Name: WarrantMaturityDate
Field.Description: Date of maturity of a warrant or structured security. YYYYMMDD.

Field.Name: CallPutFlag
Field.Description: Indicator of whether the warrant or structured product is a call or put option.

Field.Name: Style
Field.Description: Style of the warrant.

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: Padding.

Field.Name: WarrantType
Field.Description: Warrant type of the warrant.

Field.Name: CallPriceComposite
Field.Description: Call price for CBBC. See DecimalsInCallPrice for the number of decimal places. 0 means Not available.

Field.Name: EntitlementComposite
Field.Description: Entitlement of the warrant. See DecimalsInEntitlement for the number of decimal places. 0 means Not available.

Field.Name: NoWarrantsPerEntitlement
Field.Description: Number of warrants per entitlement. Not applicable if Entitlement = 0.

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: Padding.

Field.Name: NoUnderlyingSecurities
Field.Description: Number of underlying securities if the underlying security is defined in Security Definition (11) message. 0 for structured product of which the underlying is not a security defined in Security Definition, 1 for structured product of which the underlying is defined.

Field.Name: UnderlyingSecurity
Field.Description: Underlying security repeating group.

Message.Name: Liquidity Provider Message
Message.Description: The Liquidity Provider message is generated at the start of the business day for securities that have at least one liquidity provider.

Field.Name: SecurityCode
Field.Description: Uniquely identifies a security available for trading. 5 digit security codes with possible values 1 to 99999.

Field.Name: NoLiquidityProviders
Field.Description: Number of liquidity providers within this message. 1 to 50.

Field.Name: LiquidityProvider
Field.Description: Liquidity provider repeating group.

Message.Name: Currency Rate Message
Message.Description: The Currency Rate message provides the foreign exchange conversion rates between various foreign currencies and the Hong Kong dollar.

Field.Name: CurrencyCode
Field.Description: Currency code.

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: Padding.

Field.Name: CurrencyFactor
Field.Description: Currency factor conversion. A non-zero value n means all price fields for this security should be interpreted as a value equal to the price multiplied by 10^n.

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: Padding.

Field.Name: CurrencyRate
Field.Description: Rate, expressed in HKD for one foreign currency unit. 4 decimals implied.

Group.Name: UnderlyingSecurity
Group.Description: Repeating group of underlying security references.

Field.Name: UnderlyingSecurityCode
Field.Description: 5-digit code identifying the underlying security.

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: Padding.

Field.Name: LPBrokerNumber
Field.Description: Broker number of the liquidity provider.

Value.Name: Trust Fixed Income and Money Market ETF
For Inline Warrant (same as Part E up to and include HK$1.00 as per SEHK)

Composite.Name: FaceValueComposite
Composite.Description: Bond face value scaled at runtime by DecimalsInFaceValue. 0 mantissa means Not available.

Mantissa.Name: FaceValue
Mantissa.Description: Face value of a bond security. See DecimalsInFaceValue for the number of decimal places. 0 means Not available.

Decimals.Name: DecimalsInFaceValue
Decimals.Description: Number of decimal places in FaceValue. Not applicable if FaceValue = 0.

Composite.Name: CallPriceComposite
Composite.Description: CBBC call price scaled at runtime by DecimalsInCallPrice. 0 mantissa means Not available.

Mantissa.Name: CallPrice
Mantissa.Description: Call price for CBBC. See DecimalsInCallPrice for the number of decimal places. 0 means Not available.

Decimals.Name: DecimalsInCallPrice
Decimals.Description: Number of decimal places in CallPrice. Not applicable if CallPrice = 0.

Composite.Name: EntitlementComposite
Composite.Description: Warrant entitlement scaled at runtime by DecimalsInEntitlement. 0 mantissa means Not available.

Mantissa.Name: Entitlement
Mantissa.Description: Entitlement of the warrant. See DecimalsInEntitlement for the number of decimal places. 0 means Not available.

Decimals.Name: DecimalsInEntitlement
Decimals.Description: Number of decimal places in Entitlement. Not applicable if Entitlement = 0.
